Utilizing dynamic spectral processing, the plugin detects harsh frequency peaks and reduces them while incorporating dedicated tone and transient protection systems to preserve harmonics and vocal formants.

Quance includes features such as an intelligent learn function for automatic focus point placement, six source modes, up to eight focus points, and five quality settings ranging from zero-latency live monitoring to high-resolution mixing and mastering modes. entry.content:
Links: kvraudio.com | autodafe.net

Autodafe has released Mega Drum Machines V2, a completely rebuilt virtual instrument collection available as a free native plugin for macOS, Windows, and Linux in AU, VST3, and standalone formats. Building on a library originally released nearly a decade ago, the updated software features a new audio engine, a scalable interface, and expanded routing capabilities.

The plugin includes 170 drum machine kits spanning vintage, classic, and obscure electronic drum hardware. Additional features comprise 16 trigger pads across two pages, MIDI Learn and note remapping, individual group controls for tuning, panning, and volume, group mute and solo, hi-hat choke support, and up to 16 audio outputs across eight stereo buses.
